book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 已知正实数 $x, y, z$ 满足 $\sqrt{x} + \sqrt{y} + \sqrt{z} = 1$. 求证: $\frac{x^2 + yz}{\sqrt{2x^2(y + z)}} + \frac{y^2 + zx}{\sqrt{2y^2(z + x)}} + \frac{z^2 + xy}{\sqrt{2z^2(x + y)}} \geqslant 1$.
solution_md:
证法1 注意到
$$\frac{x^2 + yz}{\sqrt{2x^2(y + z)}} = \frac{x^2 - x(y + z) + yz}{\sqrt{2x^2(y + z)}} + \frac{x(y + z)}{\sqrt{2x^2(y + z)}}$$
$$= \frac{(x - y)(x - z)}{\sqrt{2x^2(y + z)}} + \sqrt{\frac{y + z}{2}}$$
$$\geqslant \frac{(x - y)(x - z)}{\sqrt{2x^2(y + z)}} + \frac{(z - x)(z - y)}{\sqrt{2z^2(x + y)}} + \sqrt{x} + \sqrt{y} + \sqrt{z}$$
以上三式相加得
$$\frac{(x - y)(x - z)}{\sqrt{2x^2(y + z)}} + \frac{(y - z)(y - x)}{\sqrt{2y^2(z + x)}} + \frac{(z - x)(z - y)}{\sqrt{2z^2(x + y)}} + \sqrt{x} + \sqrt{y} + \sqrt{z} \geqslant 0.$$
不失一般性, 设 $x \geqslant y \geqslant z$. 于是,
$$\frac{(x - y)(x - z)}{\sqrt{2x^2(y + z)}} \geqslant 0,$$
$$\frac{(y - z)(x - y)}{\sqrt{2y^2(z + x)}} - \frac{(y - z)(x - y)}{\sqrt{2y^2(z + x)}} \geqslant 0,$$
$$= (y - z)(x - y) \cdot \left[\frac{1}{\sqrt{2z^2(x + y)}} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{2y^2(z + x)}}\right].$$
事实上, 由
$$y^2(z + x) = y^2z + y^2x \geqslant yz^2 + z^2x = z^2(x + y).$$
可知式①非负.
从而, 题中不等式成立.
证法2 根据柯西不等式得
$$\left[\sqrt{\frac{yz}{x}} + \left(\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{zx}{y}} + \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{xy}{z}}\right)\right]^2$$
$$\geqslant 4\sqrt{\frac{yz}{x}}\left(\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{zx}{y}} + \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{xy}{z}}\right) = 2(y + z),$$
$$\sqrt{\frac{zx}{y}} + \left(\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{yz}{x}} + \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{xy}{z}}\right) \geqslant \sqrt{2(z + x)},$$
$$\sqrt{\frac{xy}{z}} + \left(\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{yz}{x}} + \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{zx}{y}}\right) \geqslant \sqrt{2(x + y)}.$$
